options.content:
Cross-plane fabric detail (L2). Live section = the fabric scrape-target roster from up{}. The InfiniBand/UFM, Cumulus and inventory sections below are grouped into collapsed rows: those collectors are stopped, their panels are preserved unchanged and repopulate the moment the exporters restart.
Live fabric data lives on: Ethernet switch plane  ·  NVSwitch fleet  ·  IB switches  ·  IB HCA counters  ·  Tray NIC health  ·  NVIS Home

options.content: NVSwitch tray state is owned by the NVSwitch Fleet and NVSwitch Health boards, which read the live switch_*{kind="nvswitch"} sweep. The BCM-sourced tiles that used to sit here were removed: BCM is retired. nvlmapper_* below is exporter-health only and its collector is stopped.

panels.description: nvlmapper_exporter_up. This is the only NVLink-adjacent metric that exists: seven exporter-health scalars. It reports that the mapper ran, not NVLink link state — there is no nvlink_* family in VictoriaMetrics.
